title: Bills of Lading and Transport Documents: Surrender of the Full Set at Origin
content:
For a telex release, every original of a `Bills of Lading and Transport Documents` set that is still in circulation is given up at the origin office. That act is the full-set surrender.

## Surrender at origin

Handing in the originals is reserved to the shipper printed on the document. The desk accepts it from the holder of the document record solely where that holder is the printed shipper, which is so only when the company name on its customer profile and the shipper name printed on the document agree letter for letter; if the names differ, the telex release request stays pending for the printed shipper.

The surrender is entered with the number of originals handed in. The originals still in circulation fall by that number, and the document's status becomes surrendered. No charge attaches to the surrender itself.

## Invoking `surrender_full_set_at_origin_68a55055`

The surrender is an act of the customer, not of the desk. The agent unlocks this tool with `unlock_user_discoverable_tool` so that it is handed over, and the customer themselves then performs it with `call_user_discoverable_tool`. Each performance records one surrender of originals of one set at the origin office, dated on the day it is performed.

### Parameters

| Input | Business meaning | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `bl_id` | Reference of the transport document whose originals are surrendered, as the transport document lookup returns it for the document number the caller gives | Identifier text |
| `request_id` | Reference of the telex release request on file for the document that this surrender answers, as the documentation service request lookup returns it | Identifier text |
| `bl_set_sequence` | The set to which the surrendered originals belong | Whole number without decimals; 1 stands for the first set issued, 2 for a replacement or switch set |
| `originals_count` | How many original documents this performance surrenders | Whole number of 1 or more, no decimals, in original documents |

### Return

A successful performance produces one confirmation sentence naming the surrender entry (an opaque reference beginning "bss_"), the transport document, the telex release request answered, the set number, the number of originals surrendered at the origin office and the originals still outstanding. That sentence is the success signal; the document then shows the status surrendered.

## Basis Q&A

**The consignee, who is not the documentation party, offers to hand in the originals at destination. Does that count as this surrender?** No. This surrender is made at the origin office by the printed shipper.

**Is there a fee for the surrender itself?** No. Nothing is charged by the surrender entry.
